post_title: Self-Improving AI Software Factory: Govern the Harness Loop
description: Gates a self-improving loop's candidate harness change: rejects any diff touching a protected-paths manifest (verifier, eval data, budget, sandbox, model config, logs), applies the Self-Harness rule of improving one split and degrading neither, requires every cited failure episode to be oracle-confirmed, runs score-blind vetoes, and prints PROMOTE, REJECT or FALLBACK with the evidence a named approver reads
